verses.en: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us,
verses.pt: Visto que muitos têm empreendido fazer uma narração coordenada dos fatos que entre nós se realizaram,
verses.en_web: Since many have undertaken to set in order a narrative concerning those matters which have been fulfilled among us,
verses.en_bbe: As a number of attempts have been made to put together in order an account of those events which took place among us,

verses.en: Even as they delivered them unto us, which from the beginning were eyewitnesses, and ministers of the word;
verses.pt: segundo no-los transmitiram os que desde o princípio foram testemunhas oculares e ministros da palavra,
verses.en_web: even as those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and servants of the word delivered them to us,
verses.en_bbe: As they were handed down to us by those who saw them from the first and were preachers of the word,

verses.en: It seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first, to write unto thee in order, most excellent Theophilus,
verses.pt: também a mim, depois de haver investido tudo cuidadosamente desde o começo, pareceu-me bem, ó excelentíssimo Teófilo, escrever-te uma narração em ordem.
verses.en_web: it seemed good to me also, having traced the course of all things accurately from the first, to write to you in order, most excellent Theophilus;
verses.en_bbe: It seemed good to me, having made observation, with great care, of the direction of events in their order, to put the facts in writing for you, most noble Theophilus;

verses.en: That thou mightest know the certainty of those things, wherein thou hast been instructed.
verses.pt: para que conheças plenamente a verdade das coisas em que foste instruído.
verses.en_web: that you might know the certainty concerning the things in which you were instructed.
verses.en_bbe: So that you might have certain knowledge of those things about which you were given teaching.

verses.en: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judaea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abia: and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.
verses.pt: Houve nos dias do Rei Herodes, rei da Judéia, um sacerdote chamado Zacarias, da turma de Abias; e sua mulher era descendente de Arão, e chamava-se Isabel.
verses.en_web: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the priestly division of Abijah. He had a wife of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.
verses.en_bbe: In the days of Herod, king of Judaea, there was a certain priest, by name Zacharias, of the order of Abijah; and he had a wife of the family of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.

verses.en: And they were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless.
verses.pt: Ambos eram justos diante de Deus, andando irrepreensíveis em todos os mandamentos e preceitos do Senhor.
verses.en_web: They were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.
verses.en_bbe: They were upright in the eyes of God, keeping all the rules and orders of God, and doing no wrong.

verses.en: And they had no child, because that Elisabeth was barren, and they both were now well stricken in years.
verses.pt: Mas não tinham filhos, porque Isabel era estéril, e ambos avançados em idade.
verses.en_web: But they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren, and they both were well advanced in years.
verses.en_bbe: And they were without children, because Elisabeth had never given birth, and they were at that time very old.

verses.en: And it came to pass, that while he executed the priest’s office before God in the order of his course,
verses.pt: Ora, estando ele a exercer as funções sacerdotais perante Deus, na ordem da sua turma,
verses.en_web: Now while he executed the priest’s office before God in the order of his division,
verses.en_bbe: Now it came about that in his turn he was acting as priest before God,

verses.en: According to the custom of the priest’s office, his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord.
verses.pt: segundo o costume do sacerdócio, coube-lhe por sorte entrar no santuário do Senhor, para oferecer o incenso;
verses.en_web: according to the custom of the priest’s office, his lot was to enter into the temple of the Lord and burn incense.
verses.en_bbe: And as was the way of the priests, he had to go into the Temple to see to the burning of perfumes.

verses.en: And the whole multitude of the people were praying without at the time of incense.
verses.pt: e toda a multidão do povo orava da parte de fora, à hora do incenso.
verses.en_web: The whole multitude of the people were praying outside at the hour of incense.
verses.en_bbe: And all the people were offering prayers outside, at the time of the burning of perfumes.

verses.en: And there appeared unto him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense.
verses.pt: Apareceu-lhe, então, um anjo do Senhor, em pé à direita do altar do incenso.
verses.en_web: An angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing on the right side of the altar of incense.
verses.en_bbe: And he saw an angel of the Lord in his place on the right side of the altar.

verses.en: And when Zacharias saw him, he was troubled, and fear fell upon him.
verses.pt: E Zacarias, vendo-o, ficou turbado, e o temor o assaltou.
verses.en_web: Zacharias was troubled when he saw him, and fear fell upon him.
verses.en_bbe: And Zacharias was troubled when he saw him, and fear came on him.

verses.en: But the angel said unto him, Fear not, Zacharias: for thy prayer is heard; and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name John.
verses.pt: Mas o anjo lhe disse: Não temais, Zacarias; porque a tua oração foi ouvida, e Isabel, tua mulher, te dará à luz um filho, e lhe porás o nome de João;
verses.en_web: But the angel said to him, “Don’t be afraid, Zacharias, because your request has been heard, and your wife, Elizabeth, will bear you a son, and you shall call his name John.
verses.en_bbe: But the angel said, Have no fear, Zacharias, for your prayer has come to the ears of God, and your wife Elisabeth will have a son, and his name will be John.

verses.en: And thou shalt have joy and gladness; and many shall rejoice at his birth.
verses.pt: e terás alegria e regozijo, e muitos se alegrarão com o seu nascimento;
verses.en_web: You will have joy and gladness; and many will rejoice at his birth.
verses.en_bbe: And you will be glad and have great delight; and numbers of people will have joy at his birth.

verses.en: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost, even from his mother’s womb.
verses.pt: porque ele será grande diante do Senhor; não beberá vinho, nem bebida forte; e será cheio do Espírito Santo já desde o ventre de sua mãe;
verses.en_web: For he will be great in the sight of the Lord, and he will drink no wine nor strong drink. He will be filled with the Holy Spirit, even from his mother’s womb.
verses.en_bbe: For he will be great in the eyes of the Lord; he will not take wine or strong drink; and he will be full of the Spirit of God from his birth.

verses.en: And many of the children of Israel shall he turn to the Lord their God.
verses.pt: converterá muitos dos filhos de Israel ao Senhor seu Deus;
verses.en_web: He will turn many of the children of Israel to the Lord, their God.
verses.en_bbe: And through him great numbers of the children of Israel will be turned to the Lord their God.

verses.en: And he shall go before him in the spirit and power of Elias, to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.
verses.pt: irá adiante dele no espírito e poder de Elias, para converter os corações dos pais aos filhos, e os rebeldes à prudência dos justos, a fim de preparar para o Senhor um povo apercebido.
verses.en_web: He will go before him in the spirit and power of Elijah, ‘to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children,’ and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to prepare a people prepared for the Lord.”
verses.en_bbe: And he will go before his face in the spirit and power of Elijah, turning the hearts of fathers to their children, and wrongdoers to the way of righteousness; to make ready a people whose hearts have been turned to the Lord.

verses.en: And Zacharias said unto the angel, Whereby shall I know this? for I am an old man, and my wife well stricken in years.
verses.pt: Disse então Zacarias ao anjo: Como terei certeza disso? pois eu sou velho, e minha mulher também está avançada em idade.
verses.en_web: Zacharias said to the angel, “How can I be sure of this? For I am an old man, and my wife is well advanced in years.”
verses.en_bbe: And Zacharias said to the angel, How may I be certain of this? For I am an old man, and my wife is far on in years.

verses.en: And the angel answering said unto him, I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of God; and am sent to speak unto thee, and to shew thee these glad tidings.
verses.pt: Ao que lhe respondeu o anjo: Eu sou Gabriel, que assisto diante de Deus, e fui enviado para te falar e te dar estas boas novas;
verses.en_web: The angel answered him, “I am Gabriel, who stands in the presence of God. I was sent to speak to you, and to bring you this good news.
verses.en_bbe: And the angel, answering, said, I am Gabriel, whose place is before God; I have been sent to say these words to you and to give you this good news.

verses.en: And, behold, thou shalt be dumb, and not able to speak, until the day that these things shall be performed, because thou believest not my words, which shall be fulfilled in their season.
verses.pt: e eis que ficarás mudo, e não poderás falar até o dia em que estas coisas aconteçam; porquanto não creste nas minhas palavras, que a seu tempo hão de cumprir-se.
verses.en_web: Behold, you will be silent and not able to speak, until the day that these things will happen, because you didn’t believe my words, which will be fulfilled in their proper time.”
verses.en_bbe: Now, see, you will be without voice or language till the day when these things come about, because you had not faith in my words, which will have effect at the right time.

verses.en: And the people waited for Zacharias, and marvelled that he tarried so long in the temple.
verses.pt: O povo estava esperando Zacarias, e se admirava da sua demora no santuário.
verses.en_web: The people were waiting for Zacharias, and they marveled that he delayed in the temple.
verses.en_bbe: And the people were waiting for Zacharias and were surprised because he was in the Temple for such a long time.

verses.en: And when he came out, he could not speak unto them: and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple: for he beckoned unto them, and remained speechless.
verses.pt: Quando saiu, porém, não lhes podia falar, e perceberam que tivera uma visão no santuário. E falava-lhes por acenos, mas permanecia mudo.
verses.en_web: When he came out, he could not speak to them, and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple. He continued making signs to them, and remained mute.
verses.en_bbe: And when he came out he was not able to say anything, and they saw that he had seen a vision in the Temple; and he was making signs to them without words.

verses.en: And it came to pass, that, as soon as the days of his ministration were accomplished, he departed to his own house.
verses.pt: E, terminados os dias do seu ministério, voltou para casa.
verses.en_web: When the days of his service were fulfilled, he departed to his house.
verses.en_bbe: And when the days of his work in the Temple were ended, he went back to his house.

verses.en: And after those days his wife Elisabeth conceived, and hid herself five months, saying,
verses.pt: Depois desses dias Isabel, sua mulher, concebeu, e por cinco meses se ocultou, dizendo:
verses.en_web: After these days Elizabeth, his wife, conceived, and she hid herself five months, saying,
verses.en_bbe: After that time, Elisabeth, being certain that she was to become a mother, kept herself from men's eyes for five months, saying,

verses.en: Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on me, to take away my reproach among men.
verses.pt: Assim me fez o Senhor nos dias em que atentou para mim, a fim de acabar com o meu opróbrio diante dos homens.
verses.en_web: “Thus has the Lord done to me in the days in which he looked at me, to take away my reproach among men.”
verses.en_bbe: The Lord has done this to me, for his eyes were on me, to take away my shame in the eyes of men.

verses.en: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,
verses.pt: Ora, no sexto mês, foi o anjo Gabriel enviado por Deus a uma cidade da Galiléia, chamada Nazaré,
verses.en_web: Now in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,
verses.en_bbe: Now in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a town in Galilee, named Nazareth,

verses.en: To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David; and the virgin’s name was Mary.
verses.pt: a uma virgem desposada com um varão cujo nome era José, da casa de Davi; e o nome da virgem era Maria.
verses.en_web: to a virgin pledged to be married to a man whose name was Joseph, of David’s house. The virgin’s name was Mary.
verses.en_bbe: To a virgin who was to be married to a man named Joseph, of the family of David; and the name of the virgin was Mary.

verses.en: And the angel came in unto her, and said, Hail, thou that art highly favoured, the Lord is with thee: blessed art thou among women.
verses.pt: E, entrando o anjo onde ela estava disse: Salve, agraciada; o Senhor é contigo.
verses.en_web: Having come in, the angel said to her, “Rejoice, you highly favored one! The Lord is with you. Blessed are you among women!”
verses.en_bbe: And the angel came in to her and said, Peace be with you, to whom special grace has been given; the Lord is with you.

verses.en: And when she saw him, she was troubled at his saying, and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be.
verses.pt: Ela, porém, ao ouvir estas palavras, turbou-se muito e pôs-se a pensar que saudação seria essa.
verses.en_web: But when she saw him, she was greatly troubled at the saying, and considered what kind of salutation this might be.
verses.en_bbe: But she was greatly troubled at his words, and said to herself, What may be the purpose of these words?

verses.en: And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary: for thou hast found favour with God.
verses.pt: Disse-lhe então o anjo: Não temas, Maria; pois achaste graça diante de Deus.
verses.en_web: The angel said to her, “Don’t be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.
verses.en_bbe: And the angel said to her, Have no fear, Mary, for you have God's approval.

verses.en: And, behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son, and shalt call his name JESUS.
verses.pt: Eis que conceberás e darás à luz um filho, ao qual porás o nome de Jesus.
verses.en_web: Behold, you will conceive in your womb, and give birth to a son, and will call his name ‘Jesus.’
verses.en_bbe: And see, you will give birth to a son, and his name will be Jesus.

verses.en: He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest: and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David:
verses.pt: Este será grande e será chamado filho do Altíssimo; o Senhor Deus lhe dará o trono de Davi seu pai;
verses.en_web: He will be great, and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his father, David,
verses.en_bbe: He will be great, and will be named the Son of the Most High: and the Lord God will give him the kingdom of David, his father:

verses.en: And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end.
verses.pt: e reinará eternamente sobre a casa de Jacó, e o seu reino não terá fim.
verses.en_web: and he will reign over the house of Jacob forever. There will be no end to his Kingdom.”
verses.en_bbe: He will have rule over the house of Jacob for ever, and of his kingdom there will be no end.

verses.en: Then said Mary unto the angel, How shall this be, seeing I know not a man?
verses.pt: Então Maria perguntou ao anjo: Como se fará isso, uma vez que não conheço varão?
verses.en_web: Mary said to the angel, “How can this be, seeing I am a virgin?”
verses.en_bbe: And Mary said to the angel, How may this be, because I have had no knowledge of a man?

verses.en: And the angel answered and said unto her, The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee: therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God.
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhe o anjo: Virá sobre ti o Espírito Santo, e o poder do Altíssimo te cobrirá com a sua sombra; por isso o que há de nascer será chamado santo, Filho de Deus.
verses.en_web: The angel answered her, “The Holy Spirit will come on you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. Therefore also the holy one who is born from you will be called the Son of God.
verses.en_bbe: And the angel in answer said to her, The Holy Spirit will come on you, and the power of the Most High will come to rest on you, and so that which will come to birth will be named holy, Son of God.

verses.en: And, behold, thy cousin Elisabeth, she hath also conceived a son in her old age: and this is the sixth month with her, who was called barren.
verses.pt: Eis que também Isabel, tua parenta concebeu um filho em sua velhice; e é este o sexto mês para aquela que era chamada estéril;
verses.en_web: Behold, Elizabeth, your relative, also has conceived a son in her old age; and this is the sixth month with her who was called barren.
verses.en_bbe: Even now Elisabeth, who is of your family, is to be a mother, though she is old: and this is the sixth month with her who was without children.

verses.en: For with God nothing shall be impossible.
verses.pt: porque para Deus nada será impossível.
verses.en_web: For nothing spoken by God is impossible.”
verses.en_bbe: For there is nothing which God is not able to do.

verses.en: And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.
verses.pt: Disse então Maria. Eis aqui a serva do Senhor; cumpra-se em mim segundo a tua palavra. E o anjo ausentou-se dela.
verses.en_web: Mary said, “Behold, the servant of the Lord; let it be done to me according to your word.” The angel departed from her.
verses.en_bbe: And Mary said: I am the servant of the Lord; may it be to me as you say. And the angel went away.

verses.en: And Mary arose in those days, and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Juda;
verses.pt: Naqueles dias levantou-se Maria, foi apressadamente à região montanhosa, a uma cidade de Judá,
verses.en_web: Mary arose in those days and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah,
verses.en_bbe: Then Mary got up and went quickly into the high lands, to a town of Judah;

verses.en: And entered into the house of Zacharias, and saluted Elisabeth.
verses.pt: entrou em casa de Zacarias e saudou a Isabel.
verses.en_web: and entered into the house of Zacharias and greeted Elizabeth.
verses.en_bbe: And went into the house of Zacharias and took Elisabeth in her arms.

verses.en: And it came to pass, that, when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb; and Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Ghost:
verses.pt: Ao ouvir Isabel a saudação de Maria, saltou a criancinha no seu ventre, e Isabel ficou cheia do Espírito Santo,
verses.en_web: When Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting, the baby leaped in her womb, and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.
verses.en_bbe: And when the voice of Mary came to the ears of Elisabeth, the baby made a sudden move inside her; then Elisabeth was full of the Holy Spirit,

verses.en: And she spake out with a loud voice, and said, Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb.
verses.pt: e exclamou em alta voz: Bendita és tu entre as mulheres, e bendito é o fruto do teu ventre!
verses.en_web: She called out with a loud voice, and said, “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!
verses.en_bbe: And she said with a loud voice: May blessing be on you among women, and a blessing on the child of your body.

verses.en: And whence is this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
verses.pt: E donde me provém isto, que venha visitar-me a mãe do meu Senhor?
verses.en_web: Why am I so favored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
verses.en_bbe: How is it that the mother of my Lord comes to me?

verses.en: For, lo, as soon as the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.
verses.pt: Pois logo que me soou aos ouvidos a voz da tua saudação, a criancinha saltou de alegria dentro de mim.
verses.en_web: For behold, when the voice of your greeting came into my ears, the baby leaped in my womb for joy!
verses.en_bbe: For, truly, when the sound of your voice came to my ears, the baby in my body made a sudden move for joy.

verses.en: And blessed is she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord.
verses.pt: Bem-aventurada aquela que creu que se hão de cumprir as coisas que da parte do Senhor lhe foram ditas.
verses.en_web: Blessed is she who believed, for there will be a fulfillment of the things which have been spoken to her from the Lord!”
verses.en_bbe: Happy will she be who had faith that the things which the Lord has said to her will be done.

verses.en: And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord,
verses.pt: Disse então Maria: A minha alma engrandece ao Senhor,
verses.en_web: Mary said, “My soul magnifies the Lord.
verses.en_bbe: And Mary said: My soul gives glory to God;

verses.en: And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.
verses.pt: e o meu espírito exulta em Deus meu Salvador;
verses.en_web: My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,
verses.en_bbe: My spirit is glad in God my Saviour.

verses.en: For he hath regarded the low estate of his handmaiden: for, behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.
verses.pt: porque atentou na condição humilde de sua serva. Desde agora, pois, todas as gerações me chamarão bem-aventurada,
verses.en_web: for he has looked at the humble state of his servant. For behold, from now on, all generations will call me blessed.
verses.en_bbe: For he has had pity on his servant, though she is poor and lowly placed: and from this hour will all generations give witness to the blessing which has come to me.

verses.en: For he that is mighty hath done to me great things; and holy is his name.
verses.pt: porque o Poderoso me fez grandes coisas; e santo é o seu nome.
verses.en_web: For he who is mighty has done great things for me. Holy is his name.
verses.en_bbe: For he who is strong has done great things for me; and holy is his name.

verses.en: And his mercy is on them that fear him from generation to generation.
verses.pt: E a sua misericórdia vai de geração em geração sobre os que o temem.
verses.en_web: His mercy is for generations of generations on those who fear him.
verses.en_bbe: His mercy is for all generations in whom is the fear of him.

verses.en: He hath shewed strength with his arm; he hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
verses.pt: Com o seu braço manifestou poder; dissipou os que eram soberbos nos pensamentos de seus corações;
verses.en_web: He has shown strength with his arm. He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
verses.en_bbe: With his arm he has done acts of power; he has put to flight those who have pride in their hearts.

verses.en: He hath put down the mighty from their seats, and exalted them of low degree.
verses.pt: depôs dos tronos os poderosos, e elevou os humildes.
verses.en_web: He has put down princes from their thrones. And has exalted the lowly.
verses.en_bbe: He has put down kings from their seats, lifting up on high the men of low degree.

verses.en: He hath filled the hungry with good things; and the rich he hath sent empty away.
verses.pt: Aos famintos encheu de bens, e vazios despediu os ricos.
verses.en_web: He has filled the hungry with good things. He has sent the rich away empty.
verses.en_bbe: Those who had no food he made full of good things; the men of wealth he sent away with nothing in their hands;

verses.en: He hath holpen his servant Israel, in remembrance of his mercy;
verses.pt: Auxiliou a Isabel, seu servo, lembrando-se de misericórdia
verses.en_web: He has given help to Israel, his servant, that he might remember mercy,
verses.en_bbe: His help he has given to Israel, his servant, so that he might keep in mind his mercy to Abraham and his seed for ever,

verses.en: As he spake to our fathers, to Abraham, and to his seed for ever.
verses.pt: (como falou a nossos pais) para com Abraão e a sua descendência para sempre.
verses.en_web: As he spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and his offspring forever.”
verses.en_bbe: As he gave his word to our fathers.

verses.en: And Mary abode with her about three months, and returned to her own house.
verses.pt: E Maria ficou com ela cerca de três meses; e depois voltou para sua casa.
verses.en_web: Mary stayed with her about three months, and then returned to her house.
verses.en_bbe: And Mary was with her for about three months and then went back to her house.

verses.en: Now Elisabeth’s full time came that she should be delivered; and she brought forth a son.
verses.pt: Ora, completou-se para Isabel o tempo de dar à luz, e teve um filho.
verses.en_web: Now the time that Elizabeth should give birth was fulfilled, and she gave birth to a son.
verses.en_bbe: Now it was time for Elisabeth to give birth, and she had a son.

verses.en: And her neighbours and her cousins heard how the Lord had shewed great mercy upon her; and they rejoiced with her.
verses.pt: Ouviram seus vizinhos e parentes que o Senhor lhe multiplicara a sua misericórdia, e se alegravam com ela.
verses.en_web: Her neighbors and her relatives heard that the Lord had magnified his mercy towards her, and they rejoiced with her.
verses.en_bbe: And it came to the ears of her neighbours and relations that the Lord had been very good to her, and they took part in her joy.

verses.en: And it came to pass, that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child; and they called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.
verses.pt: Sucedeu, pois, no oitavo dia, que vieram circuncidar o menino; e queriam dar-lhe o nome de seu pai, Zacarias.
verses.en_web: On the eighth day, they came to circumcise the child; and they would have called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.
verses.en_bbe: And on the eighth day they came to see to the circumcision of the child, and they would have given him the name of Zacharias, his father's name;

verses.en: And his mother answered and said, Not so; but he shall be called John.
verses.pt: Respondeu, porém, sua mãe: De modo nenhum, mas será chamado João.
verses.en_web: His mother answered, “Not so; but he will be called John.”
verses.en_bbe: But his mother made answer and said, No, his name is John.

verses.en: And they said unto her, There is none of thy kindred that is called by this name.
verses.pt: Ao que lhe disseram: Ninguém há na tua parentela que se chame por este nome.
verses.en_web: They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who is called by this name.”
verses.en_bbe: And they said, Not one of your relations has that name.

verses.en: And they made signs to his father, how he would have him called.
verses.pt: E perguntaram por acenos ao pai como queria que se chamasse.
verses.en_web: They made signs to his father, what he would have him called.
verses.en_bbe: And they made signs to his father, to say what name was to be given to him.

verses.en: And he asked for a writing table, and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they marvelled all.
verses.pt: E pedindo ele uma tabuinha, escreveu: Seu nome é João. E todos se admiraram.
verses.en_web: He asked for a writing tablet, and wrote, “His name is John.” They all marveled.
verses.en_bbe: And he sent for writing materials and put down: His name is John; and they were all surprised.

verses.en: And his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue loosed, and he spake, and praised God.
verses.pt: Imediatamente a boca se lhe abriu, e a língua se lhe soltou; louvando a Deus.
verses.en_web: His mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue freed, and he spoke, blessing God.
verses.en_bbe: And straight away his mouth was open and his tongue was free and he gave praise to God.

verses.en: And fear came on all that dwelt round about them: and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judaea.
verses.pt: Então veio temor sobre todos os seus vizinhos; e em toda a região montanhosa da Judéia foram divulgadas todas estas coisas.
verses.en_web: Fear came on all who lived around them, and all these sayings were talked about throughout all the hill country of Judea.
verses.en_bbe: And fear came on all those who were living round about them: and there was much talk about all these things in all the hill-country of Judaea.

verses.en: And all they that heard them laid them up in their hearts, saying, What manner of child shall this be! And the hand of the Lord was with him.
verses.pt: E todos os que delas souberam as guardavam no coração, dizendo: Que virá a ser, então, este menino? Pois a mão do Senhor estava com ele.
verses.en_web: All who heard them laid them up in their heart, saying, “What then will this child be?” The hand of the Lord was with him.
verses.en_bbe: And all who had word of them kept them in their minds and said, What will this child be? For the hand of the Lord was with him.

verses.en: And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Ghost, and prophesied, saying,
verses.pt: Zacarias, seu pai, ficou cheio do Espírito Santo e profetizou, dizendo:
verses.en_web: His father, Zacharias, was filled with the Holy Spirit, and prophesied, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And his father, Zacharias, was full of the Holy Spirit, and with the voice of a prophet said these words:

verses.en: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people,
verses.pt: Bendito, seja o Senhor Deus de Israel, porque visitou e remiu o seu povo,
verses.en_web: “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, for he has visited and redeemed his people;
verses.en_bbe: Praise be to the Lord, the God of Israel, for he has come to his people and made them free,

verses.en: And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David;
verses.pt: e para nós fez surgir uma salvação poderosa na casa de Davi, seu servo;
verses.en_web: and has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David
verses.en_bbe: Lifting up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David,

verses.en: As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets, which have been since the world began:
verses.pt: assim como desde os tempos antigos tem anunciado pela boca dos seus santos profetas;
verses.en_web: (as he spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets who have been from of old),
verses.en_bbe: (As he said, by the mouth of his holy prophets, from the earliest times,)

verses.en: That we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us;
verses.pt: para nos livrar dos nossos inimigos e da mão de todos os que nos odeiam;
verses.en_web: salvation from our enemies, and from the hand of all who hate us;
verses.en_bbe: Salvation from those who are against us, and from the hands of those who have hate for us;

verses.en: To perform the mercy promised to our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant;
verses.pt: para usar de misericórdia com nossos pais, e lembrar-se do seu santo pacto
verses.en_web: to show mercy towards our fathers, to remember his holy covenant,
verses.en_bbe: To do acts of mercy to our fathers and to keep in mind his holy word,

verses.en: The oath which he sware to our father Abraham,
verses.pt: e do juramento que fez a Abrão, nosso pai,
verses.en_web: the oath which he swore to Abraham, our father,
verses.en_bbe: The oath which he made to Abraham, our father,

verses.en: That he would grant unto us, that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve him without fear,
verses.pt: de conceder-nos que, libertados da mão de nossos inimigos, o servíssemos sem temor,
verses.en_web: to grant to us that we, being delivered out of the hand of our enemies, should serve him without fear,
verses.en_bbe: That we, being made free from the fear of those who are against us, might give him worship,

verses.en: In holiness and righteousness before him, all the days of our life.
verses.pt: em santidade e justiça perante ele, todos os dias da nossa vida.
verses.en_web: In holiness and righteousness before him all the days of our life.
verses.en_bbe: In righteousness and holy living before him all our days.

verses.en: And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest: for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways;
verses.pt: E tu, menino, serás chamado profeta do Altíssimo, porque irás ante a face do Senhor, a preparar os seus caminhos;
verses.en_web: And you, child, will be called a prophet of the Most High, for you will go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways,
verses.en_bbe: And you, child, will be named the prophet of the Most High: you will go before the face of the Lord, to make ready his ways;

verses.en: To give knowledge of salvation unto his people by the remission of their sins,
verses.pt: para dar ao seu povo conhecimento da salvação, na remissão dos seus pecados,
verses.en_web: to give knowledge of salvation to his people by the remission of their sins,
verses.en_bbe: To give knowledge of salvation to his people, through the forgiveness of sins,

verses.en: Through the tender mercy of our God; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us,
verses.pt: graças à entrenhável misericórdia do nosso Deus, pela qual nos há de visitar a aurora lá do alto,
verses.en_web: because of the tender mercy of our God, whereby the dawn from on high will visit us,
verses.en_bbe: Because of the loving mercies of our God, by which the dawn from heaven has come to us,

verses.en: To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.
verses.pt: para alumiar aos que jazem nas trevas e na sombra da morte, a fim de dirigir os nossos pés no caminho da paz.
verses.en_web: to shine on those who sit in darkness and the shadow of death; to guide our feet into the way of peace.”
verses.en_bbe: To give light to those in dark places, and in the shade of death, so that our feet may be guided into the way of peace.

verses.en: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, and was in the deserts till the day of his shewing unto Israel.
verses.pt: Ora, o menino crescia, e se robustecia em espírito; e habitava nos desertos até o dia da sua manifestação a Israel.
verses.en_web: The child was growing, and becoming strong in spirit, and was in the desert until the day of his public appearance to Israel.
verses.en_bbe: And the child became tall, and strong in spirit; and he was living in the waste land till the day when he came before the eyes of Israel.
